scope: repair diff f18d3a3..0bfce5c plus standing findings from pr25-r1.json

findings.claim: The D21/D22 citation mechanism in prose (agent.py comment, docs/analysis.md, verifier.py comments) is not validated by support-matrix-cites-real-cases — that eval resolves backticked case-id tokens against evals/, not bare 'D21'/'D22' numeric references against the support-matrix table, so a future renumbering or deletion of a D-row would leave the code/doc citations dangling with nothing turning red.
findings.evidence: evals/adversarial/support-matrix-cites-real-cases.json:6 expect.note is a case-id resolver, not a D-number resolver. src/browser/agent.py:64, docs/analysis.md:775-780 and src/browser/verifier.py:104-116/301-308 all cite D21/D22 by number with no eval checking those numbers still resolve to a row in docs/support-matrix.md.
findings.repro: Renumber or delete the D21 row in docs/support-matrix.md and rerun --suite invariant — nothing goes red despite agent.py citing a non-existent D21.
findings.acceptance: Either extend support-matrix-cites-real-cases (or a new case) to resolve bare D-number citations against the table, or document it as an accepted gap the way D19/D3 document their own guard ceilings.
findings.orchestrator_note: LOW -> debt by the scope rule. Worth naming plainly: this is R1's defect in its general form — an uncited claim, one level up. This repair added new D-number citations in production comments, so it is not purely pre-existing. Logged as T-R32.
